styleSelection.reason: Sargent's White Ships builds form entirely through direct watercolor washes, warm and cool wet-on-dry planes, reserved cream paper lights, and dark painted accents with no ink or graphite line.

Cool cerulean and blue-green washes across the curved ship bow, lower-left hull, and turquoise water reflections.
